SELECT s.tenant_id,s.project_id,s.snapshot_id,s.manifest,s.manifest_sha256,s.auth_epoch,s.governance_epoch,s.created_at, v.content_sha256 AS registry_hash FROM scope_snapshot s LEFT JOIN version_registry v ON v.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND v.version_id=s.snapshot_id AND v.owner_project_id=s.project_id AND v.entity_kind='SCOPE_SNAPSHOT' WHERE s.project_id=#{projectId} AND s.snapshot_id=#{snapshotId} AND OCTET_LENGTH(s.manifest)<=#{maximumBytes} LIMIT 2
SELECT upstream_version_id FROM lineage_edge e WHERE consumer_version_id=#{snapshotId} AND relation_kind='SCOPE_SNAPSHOT' ORDER BY upstream_version_id LIMIT #{maximumParents}
